add-authzclientcryptoprovider-for-author.head: 79d11c4890cc4792e3dc3535af59e4e5f7a2739d
add-authzclientcryptoprovider-for-author.prTitle: Add AuthzClientCryptoProvider for authorization client cryptographic operations

comentarios.texto: AuthzClient is a public client library that is frequently shaded or repackaged, and ServiceLoader files are commonly dropped in that process, so previously-working `AuthzClient.create(...)` calls now fail with an unrelated crypto error before the client is even constructed. Guard `CryptoIntegration.init` so a missing provider does not break client creation, either by catching `IllegalStateException` and continuing or by initializing lazily when the ECDSA conversion is first needed.

add-comprehensive-email-validation-for-b.head: 5f8a130277dbddc95d133cd2832be639baf89213
add-comprehensive-email-validation-for-b.prTitle: Add comprehensive email validation for blocked users

comentarios.texto: After the server stops blocking the address (e.g. an admin removes the `BlockedEmail` rule), the user still cannot submit because `emailValidation` returns failed from the stale `rejectedEmails` entry, and this persists for the lifetime of the controller. Clear or remove entries from `rejectedEmails` when the email input changes, or reset it when the modal is reopened.

add-groups-resource-type-and-scopes-to-a.head: 7355f05e6aafe2a7acc6434fb40c686665416606
add-groups-resource-type-and-scopes-to-a.prTitle: Add Groups resource type and scopes to authorization schema

comentarios.texto: When a resource-scoped check falls back to the all-groups type resource, permissions from other group resources in the same resource server can match the expected scope and grant access to a group the caller was never granted. Mirror `UserPermissionsV2` and only accept permissions whose `getResourceId()` equals `resource.getId()` before matching scopes.

In V2, `canView(group)` runs a resource lookup, a policy-store query and a policy evaluation for each group, so listing N groups costs N evaluations even when a single all-groups VIEW grant would answer for all of them. Restore the hoisted `canView()` check before the per-group filter.

add-guest-management-functionality-to-ex.head: 92f44dcea7ff19e9123a30c63c167a2938df5a55
add-guest-management-functionality-to-ex.prTitle: Add guest management functionality to existing bookings

comentarios.texto: Since `formatCalEvent` deep-clones `calEvent` without injecting the new guests, the `newGuests.includes(attendee.email)` branch is unreachable, so the guests added through the dialog never get notified while existing attendees receive the "new guests added" email. Send an invite to each address in `newGuests` in addition to the existing attendee fan-out.

When the booking has no attendees or the attendees array is empty in the formatted event, this throws a TypeError inside `getNodeMailerPayload` and aborts the organizer's email. Fall back to `this.calEvent.organizer.name` when `attendees[0]` is undefined.

add-html-sanitizer-for-translated-messag.head: 02f48f776f43734d1ac8914d3ad6a7115acdcb33
add-html-sanitizer-for-translated-messag.prTitle: Add HTML sanitizer for translated message resources

comentarios.texto: Every non-English message file is UTF-8 encoded, but `new PropertyResourceBundle(InputStream)` (lines 68/77) decodes as ISO-8859-1 while `Files.readString` in `verify()` uses UTF-8, so `bundle.getString(key)` returns mojibake for non-ASCII text and the sanitizer can produce spurious "Illegal HTML" build failures on legitimate translations. Read the bundle through an explicit UTF-8 reader with `new InputStreamReader(new FileInputStream(file), StandardCharsets.UTF_8)`.

A query like `count_over_time({a="b"}[$__auto])` now reaches the shard sub-request with the literal token `[$__auto]`, producing an invalid LogQL query and a failing or empty result, because `applyTemplateVariables` strips `__auto`/`__range`/`__range_s`/`__range_ms` from scopedVars (datasource.ts:1113) and only re-adds `__interval`/`__interval_ms` as literal passthroughs. Interpolate the query up front with the original scopedVars semantics (e.g. via `datasource.interpolateVariablesInQueries(request.targets, request.scopedVars, request.filters)`), or add the removed `__auto`/`__range*` scopedVars to the object passed to `applyTemplateVariables` so range-vector tokens resolve on the frontend.

The SQL expression RCE/LFI path this PR intends to block stays reachable because the `nodes.go:159-160` branch reaches `UnmarshalSQLCommand` → `NewSQLCommand` → `sql.TablesList` (DuckDB parsing) without ever calling `enableSqlExpressions`. Enforce the same check in the `TypeSQL` branch of `nodes.go` (or in `NewSQLCommand`/`UnmarshalSQLCommand`) so SQL parsing is refused regardless of the call path.

Anonymous tagging runs on each anonymous auth, so on large instances this adds a full count over the 30-day device table to a hot path for every anonymous user request. Cache the count for a short window, or enforce the limit with a cheaper bounded query such as `SELECT 1 ... LIMIT deviceLimit+1` instead of a full `COUNT(*)`.

On retry the closure prepends the query again, producing `[query, query, clientIP, ...]` so the number and positions of bound parameters no longer match the SQL, causing the UPDATE to fail or bind the wrong values on SQLite when a lock is retried. Build the full argument slice locally inside the callback (or capture `args` read-only and construct a fresh slice each call) instead of reassigning the outer `args`.

When SQLite reports the database is locked, `retryOnLocks` reruns the `WithDbSession` callback, which prepends `query` to the captured `args` again, so the retry calls `Exec(query, query, ip, ...)` and fails with mismatched bind parameters. Build the argument slice in a local variable inside the callback, or build it once outside the closure.

feat-add-calendar-cache-status-and-actio.head: 5fd11f9faa79c4aefd39975d1b0e963e5034f793
feat-add-calendar-cache-status-and-actio.prTitle: feat: add calendar cache status and actions (#22532)

comentarios.texto: Since `hasCache` ignores `delegationCredentialId` while `canDisconnect` gates on it, the "Delete cached data" action offers a `deleteCache` mutation against credentials this component otherwise treats as non-modifiable. Gate the cache branch on the same `!delegationCredentialId` condition.

feat-convert-insightsbookingservice-to-u.head: da09bc0808e7c6df1bc10e00d5acf764d94c7cc7
feat-convert-insightsbookingservice-to-u.prTitle: feat: convert InsightsBookingService to use Prisma.sql raw queries

comentarios.texto: The caching sentinel logic in the service is now completely untested, so a regression that rebuilds conditions on every call or returns stale conditions can ship without any test failing. Re-add the caching tests using the new `Prisma.sql` expectations (first call builds the condition, second call returns an equal value), mirroring the routing service suite.

When a caller embeds the result as `WHERE ${base} AND <extra>`, SQL operator precedence turns it into `A OR (B AND extra)`, which can leak rows outside the authorization scope or ignore the extra predicate. Always wrap the fragment `getBaseConditions` returns in parentheses, using `Prisma.sql` for `authConditions` and `filterConditions`, and wrap the eventTypeId OR-fragment in its own parentheses.

The signature advertises that status sync participates in source-based cycle prevention, but the guard is never applied, so an inbound status webhook from integration A can still produce outbound status updates that loop exactly as the assignee case did. Either remove the unused parameter or thread `assignment_source` through the `sync_status_outbound` task into `should_sync("outbound_status", assignment_source)`.

feat-uptime-add-ability-to-use-queues-to.head: 9966ec5a13e331659c3ea00981f9b11b0faf821f
feat-uptime-add-ability-to-use-queues-to.prTitle: feat(uptime): Add ability to use queues to manage parallelism

comentarios.texto: Because the tracker supports sparse offsets, this loop costs CPU proportional to the numeric span `max_offset - start` rather than the number of tracked offsets, so a single large gap burns CPU on every ~1s commit cycle. Iterate the sorted set of tracked offsets instead, walking `sorted(o for o in all_offsets if o >= start)` and stopping at the first offset that is missing contiguously or still outstanding.

`ensure_loaded!` is only defined on the `FallbackLocaleList` instance that config/initializers/i18n.rb assigns to `I18n.fallbacks`, so any environment where that initializer has not populated `I18n.fallbacks` with a `FallbackLocaleList` (the initializer file failing to load before `set_locale` runs, a reload in dev/test/console, or Rails reassigning `I18n.fallbacks`) raises `NoMethodError` on every request. Guard the call with `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded! if I18n.fallbacks.respond_to?(:ensure_loaded!)`, or move the preload into the backend itself so it does not depend on a specific `I18n.fallbacks` type.

OAuth2 and GitHub require the exchange `redirect_uri` to be identical to the authorize value, so omitting it makes GitHub return `redirect_uri_mismatch` with no `access_token` and the pipeline shows the generic failure page for every installation. Add `"redirect_uri": redirect_uri` to `data`, matching `OAuth2CallbackView.get_token_params` (oauth2.py:273-280).

When the frontend sends `installation_id=null` (as GitHub's user-account install flow does), the literal string `"null"` passes the `is None` check, is bound as state, and is later passed to `Integration.objects.get(external_id="null")`, which always misses and routes the user to the generic "Invalid installation request." page instead of redirecting to the app installer. Treat falsy and `"null"` values as absent, e.g. `if not installation_id or installation_id == "null": return self.redirect(self.get_app_url())`.

optimize-spans-buffer-insertion-with-evi.head: eb9623b4e787303a3bd15e10bbbdb78d59875ac6
optimize-spans-buffer-insertion-with-evi.prTitle: Optimize spans buffer insertion with eviction during insert

comentarios.texto: `span_count` receives the cardinality of the destination key `set_key` after the union, not the size of `span_key`/`parent_key` being merged, so when `set_key` already holds spans from an earlier insert (the common case for an in-progress segment) it counts those pre-existing spans and `zpopmin(set_key, span_count - 1000)` evicts far more than the intended overflow, silently discarding valid recent and root spans. Derive the count from the merged key itself, e.g. `span_count = redis.call("zcard", set_key)` after the unions (or subtract the prior `zcard(set_key)` from the `zunionstore` result) before deciding how many to pop.

`_truncate_title` is defined on `CommitContextIntegration` (line 578), not on `PRCommentWorkflow`, so this static reference raises `AttributeError` whenever the helper runs and breaks the title-truncation feature entirely. Reference `CommitContextIntegration._truncate_title(title)`, or move `_truncate_title` next to the workflow helpers.

Any write events arriving between the search watcher starting and `initWatcher` subscribing are consumed by the search reader but never reach the broadcaster, so Watch subscribers silently miss those changes. Subscribe the broadcaster by calling `initWatcher` before starting the search event-draining goroutine, or have both consume from a single shared event source.

comprehensive-workflow-reminder-manageme.head: 6048e2a86b50e81e1e3b1b467dfea5a895add3dc
comprehensive-workflow-reminder-manageme.prTitle: Comprehensive workflow reminder management for booking lifecycle events

comentarios.texto: The cron route configures `sgMail` but not the separately imported `@sendgrid/client`, so the new `client.request` cancellation calls lack SendGrid authentication and leave canceled booking reminders scheduled. Initialize `client` with `sendgridAPIKey`, as `emailReminderManager.ts` already does.

feature-can-edit-category-host-relations.head: d1c69189f3c90ecf56013a8da904da9bff9a8e19
feature-can-edit-category-host-relations.prTitle: FEATURE: Can edit category/host relationships for embedding

comentarios.texto: Administrators cannot add or edit embedding relationships for legitimate hosts such as `example.technology` because the new validation rejects suffixes longer than five letters, even though the previous hostname comparison supported them. Remove the five-letter suffix restriction or use a hostname validator that supports current domain suffixes.

implement-recovery-key-support-for-user-.head: ce2dcc537b4b1f98a335e88cfe8e0b804483252a
implement-recovery-key-support-for-user-.prTitle: Implement recovery key support for user storage providers

comentarios.texto: Because `getMyUser` returns null when the username is missing from the `users` map, accessing `myUser.recoveryCodes` throws a `NullPointerException` on every `getFederatedCredentialsStream()` call, including the new `RecoveryAuthnCodesUtils.getCredential` used during login. Return `Stream.empty()` when `myUser` is null, matching the existing guard in methods like `getDisableableCredentialTypesStream`.

fix-handle-collective-multiple-host-on-d.head: de628295646d0848226618108a52f2f1e5d04ac0
fix-handle-collective-multiple-host-on-d.prTitle: fix: handle collective multiple host on destinationCalendar

comentarios.texto: When no destination calendar matches the credentialId, the follow-up `calendar.events.patch` receives an undefined calendarId and fails, so the Meet link never reaches the description. Compute `calendarId` once as `selectedCalendar || "primary"` and use it in both the insert and the patch call.
